purpose: Teach: ウニ/髭/洋書/つば/にんにく/マヨネーズ/ヤギ/泡盛

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお寿司屋さんでウニを召し上がられたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad tried uni at the sushi restaurant.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact sharing. A small moment she noticed and thought he'd like to know. Gentle rise at the start, settling into a simple observation. The cadence of a mother telling her son about his father's day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの髭、ふさふさだよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa's beard is really fluffy.
lines.style: Sudden, bright shift in attention. Quick rise on the opening. Genuine delight — the kind of tactile observation only a 6-year-old notices and announces without filter. Open and unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが書斎に洋書をたくさん並べてらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad has arranged so many foreign books in his study.
lines.style: Reflective, gentle sharing. She's noticing things about the people she loves and offering them to her son. Measured pace. A slight warmth underneath — pride without saying it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが「しゃべる時のつばに気を付けて」って
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa said to be careful about spit when I talk.
lines.style: Earnest delivery of something he's processing. Not complaining — reporting a real concern that lodged in him. Slight worry underneath. The careful way he's turning it over, making sure he has it right.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママがにんにくをお料理に入れたわよ
lines.en: Sho, I added garlic to the cooking today.
lines.style: Another small sharing. The rhythm of a mother offering her day to her son in gentle pieces. Warm, unrushed. A natural breath before moving to the next thing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お母さんのマヨネーズ手作り好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I really like the homemade mayonnaise you make.
lines.style: Quiet affection. He's telling her something that matters to him without performance. Soft, genuine. The simple certainty of a child who knows his mother notices these things.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと動物園でヤギにエサをあげましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go feed the goats at the zoo with Dad.
lines.style: Tender invitation. Warm and present. She's painting a future moment for him — something to look forward to. Gentle rise toward his name, then soften into the offer. Genuine affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが沖縄の泡盛を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa showed me some Okinawan awamori.
lines.style: Bright, eager sharing — another small observation that caught his attention. Quick, open delivery. The slight wonder in his voice that someone showed him something new and real. Unguarded excitement.
